title: The Height of Choe's Higher-Dimensional Enneper Surface
summary: We prove that Choe's higher-dimensional Enneper hypersurfaces in $\mathbb R^{n+1}$, $3\le n\le6$, cannot be confined between two parallel hyperplanes, disproving his slab confinement conjecture. We further strengthen this conclusion by determining their precise height growth exponent.
